endpoint_and_rule.endpoint: paired ceiling-normalised R@20 POST-rerank, gemma@768 − qwen3@1024, n=133
guards: S1 PRE reproduces §I70's qwen3@1024 0.293934 and gemma@768 0.480410
S2 the rerank service is live and reordering
S3 the same list reranked twice is identical (determinism)
S4 failures counted and reported, n stated
S6 one shared chunk->page map; ceiling 888; docs in cosine order
endpoint_and_rule.rule: the bet SURVIVES iff the POST delta is > 0 with a 95% CI excluding 0

first_run_numbers_not_registered.note: recorded only so the second run can be compared against it

first_run_void.reason: a PRE-REGISTRATION PREMISE ERROR, not a harness bug: S1 required the PRE arm to reproduce §I70's rows, which are in §I70's screen convention (top-k PAGES from the full deduped ranking), while the PRE/POST contrast uses the PRODUCT's convention (pages of the top-k chunks, evaluate_rag.py:333). The two are ~0.02 apart. Restated as S1′: the §I70 convention is computed and asserted separately, and the contrast asserts both its sides are in the same convention.

meta.hyde: OFF (raw query vectors) — the cache that would freeze HyDE is built in src/pdf_ingestion/hyde_cache.py and deliberately not used here
meta.late_chunking_asymmetry: qwen3@1024 ranks the STORED dense_1024 vectors (produced with late chunking); gemma@768 embeds the chunk text directly — §I70's asymmetry, conservative for gemma

metric_conventions.contrast: pages of the top-k CHUNKS, deduped — the PRODUCT's convention (scripts/evaluate_rag.py:333-341). Used for BOTH sides of the PRE/POST contrast.
metric_conventions.i70_screen: top-k PAGES from the full deduped chunk ranking — §I70's screen convention. Reported under `arms_i70_convention` and used only to pin the instrument to the register (guard S1′(a)).
metric_conventions.why_both: the two are ~0.02 apart and are NOT the same number; the first run was VOID because S1 compared one against the other
